newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market ends a shade lower.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market ends a shade lower.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market ended Friday slightly weaker from the previous session, but some blue chips managed to climb to higher closing levels on growing investor interest.
Operators said they expected a bearish phase in the early days of next week, with a rally seen setting off by Wednesday.
Three independent indices, computed by securities companies based on average prices and market capitalisation, inched down from Thursday's levels.
The VAB-RA all-share index fell 0.3 percent to 6,442.2 points, BIG-OTC moved lower by 0.2 percent to 4,936.34 and CAS-RQ slipped 1.29 percent to 1,092 points.
Oil refineries and cement makers remained in focus.
Petrobrazi oil refinery closed 1,000 lei stronger at 43,500, while refinery Arpechim picked up 500 lei to close at 42,000.
Cement maker Moldocim gained 1,000 lei to 54,000, while another cement maker, Romcim, shed 3,000 to 126,000 at close.
Turnover fell to 28.2 billion lei from 30.8 billion lei on Thursday.
